message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
s=open('/tmp/gen_makefile.py').read()
old='''    o = s.replace("/", "_").replace(".cpp", ".o").replace(".c", ".o")'''
new='''    o = s.replace("/", "_")
    if o.endswith(".cpp"): o = o[:-4]+".o"
    elif o.endswith(".cc"): o = o[:-3]+".o"
    elif o.endswith(".c"): o = o[:-2]+".o"'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open('/tmp/gen_makefile.py','w').write(s)
print("patched obj naming")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/gen_makefile.py
grep -o "poly2tri[^ ]*" /tmp/Makefile.assimp | head

message.content: The object naming is broken because `.cc` files get `.oc` (the replace only handles `.cpp` and `.c`). Let me fix the object name generation to handle `.cc`.
